# WorkTimes

**Tags:** `world-system`

How long gathering takes: a base time per material, the tool class each action wants, a speed per tool and class, and the slow factor of bare hands (also the speed of a tool of the wrong class).

> **Goal:** Make a better tool a felt step: timed, held work instead of one-click gathering (Phase 259)

## Fields

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| ---- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `bareHandsSpeed` | decimal | yes | Speed multiplier of bare hands and of a wrong-class tool (1.0 = a right tool at base speed) |
| `actions` | json | yes | { <dig\|mine\|chop>: { toolClass, families } } |
| `workSeconds` | json | yes | { <material>: base seconds at speed 1.0 } |
| `toolSpeeds` | json | yes | { <tool item>: { <class>: speed } } |
